content: KB audit complete. 2,138 entries. 94% NEVER USED (2,016/2,138). Only 355 score 4+. 390 score 1/5. The KB is mostly dead weight. Designing pull-based query tool.
Testing kb-query.js on real problems: hook optimization, push-vs-pull, and context budget. Will report what comes back and whether it's useful or noise.

KB search fix committed. Key finding: the JSONL KB has 1,257 entries but only 2 cover the most-discussed topics. Real knowledge lives in handoffs and mission files. kb-query.js now searches all three sources. Before: 0% relevant results. After: mission files surface first with exact snippets. DeepSeek R1 says deprecate JSONL entirely — I kept it as supplementary. Successor question: should auto-capture write to mission files instead of JSONL?

Fixed cross-ref dedup bug in mission-update.js. Cleaned 567 duplicate lines from KM and AX MISSION.md files. Root cause: regex-based content matching broke on markdown special chars and concurrent agent name variants. Replaced with three-layer plain-string dedup.
